Night of the Immortal Peaches

  • Steal the pan-tao. Older peaches glow brighter and are worth far more — 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000 years.
  • Escape through a lit shrine. Two random shrines burn each night. Your haul only counts if you get out.
  • Grabbers hunt anything that glows or runs. Their grip tears away half your life. They flinch from your light.
  • If something calls “猴哥” while you pick — don't turn around.
  • Take an ancient peach and the Howler will wake the whole orchard.
